{{Quote|For generations, the name Tagge has been synonymous with that of the Republic, as the blood of one of the original Founders continues to flow through our veins. We would be remiss not to broadcast to the galaxy at large our undying devotion to the union, our faith in the Supreme Chancellor, and our dedication to serving the people of the Republic.|Baroness Sanya Tagge|<ref name="Tagge Loyalists">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|business/13328_1.html|House of Tagge Sides with Loyalists}}</ref>}}
The '''House of Tagge''', also known as the '''Tagge family''' was a family of wealthy [[Human/Legends|Human]] nobles centralized on [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]]. Its progenitor was said to have been one of the original [[Core Founder/Legends|Founders]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[25,053 BBY]].

The head of the family held the rank either of [[Baron/Legends|baron or baroness]], depending on gender. An official complete list of the heads of House Tagge did not exist, but three had been established: [[Sanya Tagge/Legends|Sanya Tagge]] was head of the house in the period leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but there is no indication as to when she ascended to this position. Her oldest son, [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]], became baron and head of the family early in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]; at the age of seventeen. Orman became incapacitated in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and died later that same year, so the position was passed to the youngest son, [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric Tagge]].

The House of Tagge owned and operated the [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]]&mdash;one of the most powerful megacorporations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;as well as a private military of 5,000 armed scout starships and a million soldiers. They supported the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] throughout the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;although they did not offer the Republic the use of their paramilitary forces&mdash;and following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], were firm supporters of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the House of Tagge supported the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] with a flotilla of [[Tagge battlecruiser|private battlecruisers]] during the [[Yavin blockade]], as Baron Orman Tagge was trying to usurp [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] position as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] right hand man.

The House of Tagge framed and disgraced the rival [[Balfed family|House of Balfed]].
